In this notebook, I will compute all differential expression and gene set enrichment analyses. Because there are so few 10x version 2 samples among what will be analyzed, will check PCA before including 10x version as a blocking variable (may not include if not a clear effect or 0-1 v2 sample numbers in a condition).

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(fgsea)
library(DESeq2)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

colPre <-  colcCD
colPost <- "#ee82ee"
prepostColVec <- c("PreTx"=colPre, "PostTx"=colPost)

colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)

colCellgroups <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
cellgroups <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")
names(colCellgroups) <- cellgroups


`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

min.counts.ct <- 250
min.counts.cst <- 50

pathways <- gmtPathways("../../../data/msigdb/c2.cp.reactome.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt")

source("../functions/FeaturesFilter.R")
```

## Thelper

### Differential Expression

```{r}
annos.ccduc.thelper <- list(Thelper = c("Thelper"))
annos.ccduc.thelper
```

```{r}
# pseudobulk the counts based on donor-condition-annotation
pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list <- lapply(names(annos.ccduc.thelper), function(anno){
  thisobj <- subset(seuobj.ccduc, subset = cellsubtype %in% annos.ccduc.thelper[[anno]])
  
  # ensure enough cells in sample
  cellcounts <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table
  samplesToKeep <- cellcounts[cellcounts > 10] %>% names
  
  count.df <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table %>% data.frame()
  colnames(count.df) <- c("biopsy", "cellcount")
  
  thisobj$diagSub <- paste0("_", thisobj$diagSub)
  thisobj$version_10x <- paste0("_", thisobj$version_10x)
  

  aggobj <- AggregateExpression(subset(thisobj, subset = biopsy %in% samplesToKeep), slot = "counts",
                      assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("biopsy", "diagSub", "version_10x"))
  
  aggobj$biopsy <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,1]
  
  aggobj <- AddMetaData(aggobj,
                        left_join(aggobj@meta.data %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("rowname"),
                                  count.df,
                                  by = "biopsy") %>%
                          column_to_rownames("rowname"))

  aggobj$anno <- anno
  
  aggobj$diagSub <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,2]
  aggobj$diagSub <- fct_relevel(aggobj$diagSub, c("cCD", "UC"))
  
  aggobj$version_10x <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,3]
  aggobj$version_10x <- fct_relevel(aggobj$version_10x, c("v1", "v2"))  

  return(aggobj)
})

names(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list) <- names(annos.ccduc.thelper)

pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list
```

```{r}
lapply(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list, function(x) x@meta.data)
```

```{r}
min.samples <- 15 
for (anno in names(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list)){
  geneNum <- (rowSums(GetAssayData(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list[[anno]], slot = "counts") >= min.counts.cst) >= min.samples) %>% sum
  message(sprintf("# Genes in %s: %i", anno, geneNum))
}
```

```{r}
pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt <- lapply(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list, function(anno){
  genesToKeep <- rownames(anno)[(rowSums(GetAssayData(anno, slot = "counts") >= min.counts.cst) >= min.samples)]
  genesToKeepFiltered <- FeaturesFilter(features = genesToKeep, removeTR = T, removeIG = T, removeMito = T, removeRibo = T)
  group.filt <- anno[c(genesToKeepFiltered)]
  return(group.filt)
})
pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt
```

```{r}
pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt$Thelper@meta.data
```

```{r}
# check 10x version PCA
lapply(names(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt), function(anno){
  ddsSE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt[[anno]]@assays$RNA@counts), 
                                        colData = pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt[[anno]]@meta.data, 
                                        design = ~ version_10x + diagSub)
  ddsSE <- vst(ddsSE)

  plotPCA(ddsSE, intgroup=c("version_10x")) + ggtitle(anno)
})
```

```{r}
# perform DE and extract results
res.ccduc.thelper.list <- lapply(names(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt), function(anno){
  ddsSE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt[[anno]]@assays$RNA@counts), 
                                        colData = pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt[[anno]]@meta.data, 
                                        design = ~ version_10x + diagSub)
  ddsSE <- DESeq(ddsSE)
  res.plot <- results(ddsSE, contrast=c("diagSub","UC","cCD"))
  
  rangeVal <- res.plot$log2FoldChange %>% range %>% abs %>% max
  plotMA(res.plot, ylim = c(-rangeVal, rangeVal), main = anno)

  res.out <- results(ddsSE, contrast=c("diagSub","UC","cCD"), tidy=T) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = row) %>% arrange(padj)
  
  return(res.out)
})

names(res.ccduc.thelper.list) <- names(pbulk.ccduc.thelper.list.filt)
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
ggplot(de.ccduc.thelper.df %>% 
         mutate(labelname = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, gene, NA)) %>% 
         mutate(diagSub = ifelse(sign(stat) == 1, "UC", "cCD")) %>% 
         mutate(pointfill = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, diagSub, "Not DE")) %>% 
         mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("cCD", "UC"))), 
       aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), label = labelname)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, lty = 2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, lty = 2) +  
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", aes(fill = pointfill)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(color = pointfill, size = -log10(padj)), seed = thisseed,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 2) +
  geom_label_repel(color = "black", seed = thisseed, aes(size = -log10(padj)),
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec, limits = c("cCD", "UC")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(diagSubColVec, "Not DE" = "gray50"), limits = c("cCD", "Not DE", "UC"), 
                    labels = c("cCD" = "Enriched in cCD", 
                               "Not DE" = "Not DE", 
                               "UC" = "Enriched in UC")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2,2)) +
  facet_wrap(~annotation, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    size = "Percent Expression",
    x = "Average Log2 FC",
    y = "-Log10 P Value (Adjusted)"
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", color="black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color="black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  ) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 8)))
```

### GSEA

```{r}
ranks.ccduc.ibdassoc.list <- lapply(res.ccduc.ibdassoc.list, function(this.res){
  these.ranks <- this.res %>% 
    arrange(stat) %>% 
    pull(stat, gene)
  
  length(these.ranks) %>% print

  these.ranks %>% head %>% print
  message("\n")

  these.ranks %>% tail %>% print
  message("\n")
  
  return(these.ranks)
})
```

```{r}
set.seed(thisseed)

fgseaRes.ccduc.ibdassoc.list <- lapply(ranks.ccduc.ibdassoc.list, function(this.rank) {
  this.fgsea <- fgsea(pathways=pathways, stats=this.rank, nPermSimple = 1e3, minSize = 15, maxSize = 100, )
  
  this.fgsea <- this.fgsea %>% 
    mutate(pathway = str_remove(pathway, "REACTOME_")) %>% 
    mutate(pathway = str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " ")) %>% 
    rowwise %>% 
    mutate(leadingEdgeNum = length(leadingEdge)) %>% 
    mutate(Genes = paste(unlist(leadingEdge), collapse = " ")) %>% 
    ungroup %>% 
    select(-leadingEdge)
  
  this.fgsea %>% arrange(padj) %>% print
  
  return(this.fgsea)
})
```

```{r}
fgseaRes.ccduc.ibdassoc.df <- plyr::ldply(fgseaRes.ccduc.ibdassoc.list, .id = "annotation") %>% arrange(padj)
fgseaRes.ccduc.ibdassoc.df
```


```{r, fig.height=12, fig.width=20}
fgseaRes.ccduc.ibdassoc.df %>% 
  mutate(diagSub = ifelse(sign(NES) == 1, "UC", "cCD")) %>% 
  mutate(NES = ifelse(sign(NES) == -1, -NES, NES)) %>% 
  filter(padj <= 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(annotation, diagSub) %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(pathway = str_wrap(pathway, width = 35)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(pathway, NES), x = NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=-log10(padj)), col = "black", lwd = 1.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  geom_text(size = 2, fontface="bold", hjust=1, aes(label = str_wrap(Genes, 60), x = NES-0.01)) +
  facet_wrap(diagSub~annotation, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    y=NULL, 
    fill = "Adjusted\nPvalue\n(-Log10)",
    x="Normalized Enrichment Score",
  ) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", vjust = 0.75),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 2),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}

  ColEpi = c("ColEpi"),
  Stroma = c("Stroma"),
  Myeloid = c("Myeloid"),
  Plasma = c("Plasma"),
  BCell = c("BCell"),
```

```{r}
# pseudobulk the counts based on donor-condition-annotation
pbulk.ccdnoa.celltypes.list <- lapply(names(annos.ccdnoa.celltypes), function(anno){
  thisobj <- subset(seuobj.ccdnoa, subset = celltype %in% annos.ccdnoa.celltypes[[anno]])
  
  # ensure enough cells in sample
  cellcounts <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table
  samplesToKeep <- cellcounts[cellcounts > 10] %>% names
  
  count.df <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table %>% data.frame()
  colnames(count.df) <- c("biopsy", "cellcount")
  
  thisobj$atnf <- paste0("_", thisobj$atnf)
  thisobj$version_10x <- paste0("_", thisobj$version_10x)
  
  
  aggobj <- AggregateExpression(subset(thisobj, subset = biopsy %in% samplesToKeep), slot = "counts",
                                assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("biopsy", "atnf", "version_10x"))
  
  aggobj$biopsy <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,1]
  
  aggobj <- AddMetaData(aggobj,
                        left_join(aggobj@meta.data %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("rowname"),
                                  count.df,
                                  by = "biopsy") %>%
                          column_to_rownames("rowname"))
  
  aggobj$anno <- anno
  
  aggobj$atnf <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,2]
  aggobj$atnf <- fct_relevel(aggobj$atnf, c("NOA", "aTNF"))
  
  aggobj$version_10x <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,3]
  aggobj$version_10x <- fct_relevel(aggobj$version_10x, c("v1", "v2"))  
  
  return(aggobj)
})
```

```{r}
  ColEpi = c("ColEpi"),
  Stroma = c("Stroma"),
  Myeloid = c("Myeloid"),
```

### Differential Expression

```{r}
# pseudobulk the counts based on donor-condition-annotation
pbulk.ccdfrpr.celltypes.list <- lapply(names(annos.ccdfrpr.celltypes), function(anno){
  thisobj <- subset(seuobj.ccdfrpr, subset = celltype %in% annos.ccdfrpr.celltypes[[anno]])
  
  # ensure enough cells in sample
  cellcounts <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table
  samplesToKeep <- cellcounts[cellcounts > 10] %>% names
  
  count.df <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table %>% data.frame()
  colnames(count.df) <- c("biopsy", "cellcount")
  
  thisobj$antitnf_response <- paste0("_", thisobj$antitnf_response)
  thisobj$version_10x <- paste0("_", thisobj$version_10x)
  
  
  aggobj <- AggregateExpression(subset(thisobj, subset = biopsy %in% samplesToKeep), slot = "counts",
                                assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("biopsy", "antitnf_response", "version_10x"))
  
  aggobj$biopsy <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,1]
  
  aggobj <- AddMetaData(aggobj,
                        left_join(aggobj@meta.data %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("rowname"),
                                  count.df,
                                  by = "biopsy") %>%
                          column_to_rownames("rowname"))
  
  aggobj$anno <- anno
  
  aggobj$antitnf_response <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,2]
  aggobj$antitnf_response <- fct_relevel(aggobj$antitnf_response, c("FR", "PR"))
  
  aggobj$version_10x <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,3]
  aggobj$version_10x <- fct_relevel(aggobj$version_10x, c("v1", "v2"))  
  
  return(aggobj)
})
```

### GSEA

```{r}
ranks.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.list <- lapply(res.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.list, function(this.res){
  these.ranks <- this.res %>% 
    arrange(stat) %>% 
    pull(stat, gene)
  
  length(these.ranks) %>% print
  
  these.ranks %>% head %>% print
  message("\n")
  
  these.ranks %>% tail %>% print
  message("\n")
  
  return(these.ranks)
})
```

```{r}
set.seed(thisseed)

fgseaRes.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.list <- lapply(ranks.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.list, function(this.rank) {
  this.fgsea <- fgsea(pathways=pathways, stats=this.rank, nPermSimple = 1e3, minSize = 15, maxSize = 100)
  
  this.fgsea <- this.fgsea %>% 
    mutate(pathway = str_remove(pathway, "REACTOME_")) %>% 
    mutate(pathway = str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " ")) %>% 
    rowwise %>% 
    mutate(leadingEdgeNum = length(leadingEdge)) %>% 
    mutate(Genes = paste(unlist(leadingEdge), collapse = " ")) %>% 
    ungroup %>% 
    select(-leadingEdge)
  
  this.fgsea %>% arrange(padj) %>% print
  
  return(this.fgsea)
})
```

### Differential Expression

```{r}
# pseudobulk the counts based on donor-condition-annotation
pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list <- lapply(names(annos.ucnoa.celltypes), function(anno){
  thisobj <- subset(seuobj.ucnoa, subset = celltype %in% annos.ucnoa.celltypes[[anno]])
  
  # ensure enough cells in sample
  cellcounts <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table
  samplesToKeep <- cellcounts[cellcounts > 10] %>% names
  
  count.df <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table %>% data.frame()
  colnames(count.df) <- c("biopsy", "cellcount")
  
  thisobj$atnf <- paste0("_", thisobj$atnf)
  thisobj$version_10x <- paste0("_", thisobj$version_10x)
  
  
  aggobj <- AggregateExpression(subset(thisobj, subset = biopsy %in% samplesToKeep), slot = "counts",
                                assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("biopsy", "atnf", "version_10x"))
  
  aggobj$biopsy <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,1]
  
  aggobj <- AddMetaData(aggobj,
                        left_join(aggobj@meta.data %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("rowname"),
                                  count.df,
                                  by = "biopsy") %>%
                          column_to_rownames("rowname"))
  
  aggobj$anno <- anno
  
  aggobj$atnf <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,2]
  aggobj$atnf <- fct_relevel(aggobj$atnf, c("NOA", "aTNF"))
  
  aggobj$version_10x <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,3]
  aggobj$version_10x <- fct_relevel(aggobj$version_10x, c("v1", "v2"))  
  
  return(aggobj)
})

names(pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list) <- names(annos.ucnoa.celltypes)

pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list
```

```{r}
  message(sprintf("# Genes in %s: %i", anno, geneNum))
}
```

```{r}
pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list.filt <- lapply(pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list, function(anno){
  genesToKeep <- rownames(anno)[(rowSums(GetAssayData(anno, slot = "counts") >= min.counts.ct) >= min.samples)]
  genesToKeepFiltered <- FeaturesFilter(features = genesToKeep, removeTR = T, removeIG = T, removeMito = T, removeRibo = T)
  group.filt <- anno[c(genesToKeepFiltered)]
  return(group.filt)
})
pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list.filt
```

```{r}
# check 10x version PCA

  ddsSE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list.filt[[anno]]@assays$RNA@counts), 
                                        colData = pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list.filt[[anno]]@meta.data, 
                                        design = ~ version_10x + atnf)
  ddsSE <- vst(ddsSE)

  plotPCA(ddsSE, intgroup=c("version_10x")) + ggtitle(anno)
})
```

```{r}
# perform DE and extract results
res.ucnoa.celltypes.list <- lapply(names(pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list.filt), function(anno){
  ddsSE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list.filt[[anno]]@assays$RNA@counts), 
                                  colData = pbulk.ucnoa.celltypes.list.filt[[anno]]@meta.data, 
                                  design = ~ version_10x + atnf)
  ddsSE <- DESeq(ddsSE)
  res.plot <- results(ddsSE, contrast=c("atnf","aTNF","NOA"))
  
  rangeVal <- res.plot$log2FoldChange %>% range %>% abs %>% max
  plotMA(res.plot, ylim = c(-rangeVal, rangeVal), main = anno)
  
  res.out <- results(ddsSE, contrast=c("atnf","aTNF","NOA"), tidy=T) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = row) %>% arrange(padj)
  
  return(res.out)
})
```

### GSEA


```{r}
ranks.ucnoa.celltypes.list <- lapply(res.ucnoa.celltypes.list, function(this.res){
  these.ranks <- this.res %>% 
    arrange(stat) %>% 
    pull(stat, gene)
  
  length(these.ranks) %>% print
  
  these.ranks %>% head %>% print
  message("\n")
  
  these.ranks %>% tail %>% print
  message("\n")
  
  return(these.ranks)
})
```

```{r}
set.seed(thisseed)

fgseaRes.ucnoa.celltypes.list <- lapply(ranks.ucnoa.celltypes.list, function(this.rank) {
  this.fgsea <- fgsea(pathways=pathways, stats=this.rank, nPermSimple = 1e3, minSize = 15, maxSize = 100, )
  
  this.fgsea <- this.fgsea %>% 
    mutate(pathway = str_remove(pathway, "REACTOME_")) %>% 
    mutate(pathway = str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " ")) %>% 
    rowwise %>% 
    mutate(leadingEdgeNum = length(leadingEdge)) %>% 
    mutate(Genes = paste(unlist(leadingEdge), collapse = " ")) %>% 
    ungroup %>% 
    select(-leadingEdge)
  
  this.fgsea %>% arrange(padj) %>% print
  
  return(this.fgsea)
})
```

```{r, fig.height=24, fig.width=20}
  mutate(antitnf_response = fct_relevel(antitnf_response, c("PR", "NR"))) %>% 
  mutate(NES = ifelse(sign(NES) == -1, -NES, NES)) %>% 
  filter(padj <= 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(annotation, antitnf_response) %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(pathway = str_wrap(pathway, width = 35)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(pathway, NES), x = NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=-log10(padj)), col = "black", lwd = 1.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  geom_text(size = 2, fontface="bold", hjust=1, aes(label = str_wrap(Genes, 60), x = NES-0.01)) +
  facet_wrap(antitnf_response~annotation, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    y=NULL, 
    fill = "Adjusted\nPvalue\n(-Log10)",
    x="Normalized Enrichment Score",
  ) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", vjust = 0.75),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(linewidth = 2),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```

### Differential Expression

```{r}
# pseudobulk the counts based on donor-condition-annotation
pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list <- lapply(names(annos.ucprnr.ibdassoc), function(anno){
  thisobj <- subset(seuobj.ucprnr, subset = cellstate %in% annos.ucprnr.ibdassoc[[anno]])
  
  # ensure enough cells in sample
  cellcounts <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table
  samplesToKeep <- cellcounts[cellcounts > 10] %>% names
  
  count.df <- thisobj$biopsy %>% droplevels %>% table %>% data.frame()
  colnames(count.df) <- c("biopsy", "cellcount")
  
  thisobj$antitnf_response <- paste0("_", thisobj$antitnf_response)
  thisobj$version_10x <- paste0("_", thisobj$version_10x)
  
  
  aggobj <- AggregateExpression(subset(thisobj, subset = biopsy %in% samplesToKeep), slot = "counts",
                                assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("biopsy", "antitnf_response", "version_10x"))
  
  aggobj$biopsy <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,1]
  
  aggobj <- AddMetaData(aggobj,
                        left_join(aggobj@meta.data %>%
                                    rownames_to_column("rowname"),
                                  count.df,
                                  by = "biopsy") %>%
                          column_to_rownames("rowname"))
  
  aggobj$anno <- anno
  
  aggobj$antitnf_response <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,2]
  aggobj$antitnf_response <- fct_relevel(aggobj$antitnf_response, c("PR", "NR"))
  
  aggobj$version_10x <- str_split(colnames(aggobj), "__", simplify = T)[,3]
  aggobj$version_10x <- fct_relevel(aggobj$version_10x, c("v1", "v2"))  
  
  return(aggobj)
})

names(pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list) <- names(annos.ucprnr.ibdassoc)

pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list
```

```{r}
pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt <- lapply(pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list, function(anno){
  genesToKeep <- rownames(anno)[(rowSums(GetAssayData(anno, slot = "counts") >= min.counts.cst) >= min.samples)]
  genesToKeepFiltered <- FeaturesFilter(features = genesToKeep, removeTR = T, removeIG = T, removeMito = T, removeRibo = T)
  group.filt <- anno[c(genesToKeepFiltered)]
  return(group.filt)
})
pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt
```

```{r}
# check 10x version PCA
lapply(names(pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt), function(anno){
  ddsSE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt[[anno]]@assays$RNA@counts), 
                                        colData = pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt[[anno]]@meta.data, 
                                        design = ~ version_10x + antitnf_response)
  ddsSE <- vst(ddsSE)

  plotPCA(ddsSE, intgroup=c("version_10x")) + ggtitle(anno)
})
```

```{r}
# perform DE and extract results
res.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list <- lapply(names(pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt), function(anno){
  ddsSE <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.matrix(pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt[[anno]]@assays$RNA@counts), 
                                  colData = pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt[[anno]]@meta.data, 
                                  design = ~antitnf_response)
  ddsSE <- DESeq(ddsSE)
  res.plot <- results(ddsSE, contrast=c("antitnf_response","NR","PR"))
  
  rangeVal <- res.plot$log2FoldChange %>% range %>% abs %>% max
  plotMA(res.plot, ylim = c(-rangeVal, rangeVal), main = anno)
  
  res.out <- results(ddsSE, contrast=c("antitnf_response","NR","PR"), tidy=T) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = row) %>% arrange(padj)
  
  return(res.out)
})

names(res.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list) <- names(pbulk.ucprnr.ibdassoc.list.filt)
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
ggplot(de.ucprnr.ibdassoc.df %>%

         mutate(antitnf_response = ifelse(sign(stat) == 1, "NR", "PR")) %>% 
         mutate(pointfill = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, antitnf_response, "Not DE")) %>% 
         mutate(antitnf_response = fct_relevel(antitnf_response, c("PR", "NR"))), 
       aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), label = labelname)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, lty = 2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, lty = 2) +  
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", aes(fill = pointfill)) +

                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 2) +
  geom_label_repel(color = "black", seed = thisseed, aes(size = -log10(padj)),
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 50, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(atnfColVec, "Not DE" = "gray50"), limits = c("PR", "NR")) +

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2,2)) +
  facet_wrap(~annotation, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +

    color = NULL,

    axis.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  ) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 8)))
```
